summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Narada advising Krishna to resolve clan conflict with gentleness, then tells a parable about exposing corrupt ministers and protecting informants.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Kalakavrikshiya walks through the kingdom carrying a caged crow, proclaiming that the bird reveals the secret crimes of the king’s officers.
At night, corrupt ministers secretly shoot an arrow into the caged crow while the sage sleeps nearby.
Narada stands before Krishna explaining that forgiveness, generosity, and gentle words are a weapon sharper than steel.
